tha-ap549:1.1: Abhaya.] Padumuttaro nāma jino sabbadhammesu cakkhumā / ito satasahassamhi kappe uppajji nāyako. // //
tha-ap549:2.1: Saraṇāgamane kañci nivesesi Tathāgato / kañci sīle nivesesi dasakammapathuttame. // //
tha-ap549:3.1: Deti kassaci so vīro sāmaññaphalam uttamaṃ / samāpattī tathā aṭṭha tisso vijjā pavecchati. // //
tha-ap549:4.1: Chalabhiññāsu yojeti kañci sattaṃ naruttamo / deti kassaci so nātho catasso paṭisambhidā. // //
tha-ap549:5.1: Bodhaneyyaṃ pajaṃ disvā asaṅkheyye 'pi yojane / khaṇena upagantvāna vineti narasārathi. // //
tha-ap549:6.1: Tadā 'haṃ Haṃsavatiyā ahosiṃ brāhmaṇatrajo / pāragū sabbavedānaṃ veyyākaraṇasammato, // //
tha-ap549:7.1: Niruttiyā ca kusalo nighaṇṭe ca visārado / padako keṭubhavidū chandovicitikovido. // //
tha-ap549:8.1: Jaṅghāvihāraṃ vicaraṃ Haṃsārāmam upecc' ahaṃ / addasaṃ vadataṃ seṭṭhaṃ mahājana-purakkhataṃ // //
tha-ap549:9.1: Desentaṃ virajaṃ dhammaṃ paccanīka-matī ahaṃ / upetvā tassa vākyāni sutvāna vimalān' ahaṃ. // //
tha-ap549:10.1: Vyāhaṭaṃ puna-r-uttañ ca apatthaṃ 'va niratthakaṃ / nāddasaṃ tassa munino tato pabbajito ahaṃ. // //
tha-ap549:11.1: Naciren' eva kālena sabbasatthavisārado / nipuṇe Buddhavacane ahosiṃ gaṇisammato. // //
tha-ap549:12.1: Tadā catasso gāthāyo ganthavitvā suvyañjanā / santhavitvā tilokaggaṃ desayissaṃ dine dine: // //
tha-ap549:13.1: "Viratto si mahāvīro saṃsāre sabhaye vasan / karuṇāya na nibbāyi tato kāruṇiko muni. // //
tha-ap549:14.1: Puthujjano 'va yo satto na kilesavaso ahu / sampajāno satiyutto tasmā eso acintiyo. // //
tha-ap549:15.1: Dubbalāni kilesāni yassa sayakatāni me / ñāṇaggiparidaḍḍhāni na khīyisu tadabbhutaṃ. // //
tha-ap549:16.1: Yo sabbalokassa guru loko yassa tathā guru / tathāpi lokacariyā loko tassānuvattako". // //
tha-ap549:17.1: Evamādīhi yaṃ Buddhaṃ kittayaṃ dhammadesakaṃ / yāvajīvaṃ karitvāna gato saggaṃ tato cuto. // //
tha-ap549:18.1: Satasahasse ito kappe yaṃ Buddhaṃ abhikittayiṃ / duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi kittanāya idaṃ phalaṃ. // //
tha-ap549:19.1: Devaloke mahārajjaṃ rajjapādesikañ ca yaṃ / cakkavatti mahārajjaṃ bahuso 'nubhaviṃ ahaṃ. // //
tha-ap549:20.1: Duve bhave pajāyāmi devatte atha mānuse / aññaṃ gatiṃ na jānāmi kittanāya idaṃ phalaṃ. // //
tha-ap549:21.1: Duve kule pajāyāmi khattiye atha brāhmaṇe / nīce kule na jānāmi kittanāya idaṃ phalaṃ. // //
tha-ap549:22.1: Pacchime ca bhave dāni Giribbaja-puruttame / rañño *'haṃ Bimbisā*rassa putto nāmena c' Ābhayo. // //
tha-ap549:23.1: Pāpamittavasaṃ gantvā Nigaṇṭhena vimohito / pesito Nāṭaputtena Buddhaseṭṭhaṃ upecc ahaṃ. // //
tha-ap549:24.1: Pucchitvā nipuṇaṃ pañhaṃ sutvā vyākaraṇ-uttamaṃ / pabbajitvāna naciraṃ arahattaṃ apāpuṇiṃ. // //
tha-ap549:25.1: Kittayitvā jinavaraṃ kittito homi sabbadā / sugandhadehavadano āsiṃ sukhasamappito. // //
tha-ap549:26.1: Tikkha-hāsa-lahu-pañño mahāpañño tath' ev' ahaṃ / vicittapaṭibhāno ca tassa kammassa vāhasā. // //
tha-ap549:27.1: AbhitthavitvāPadumuttarāhaṃ pasannacitto asamaṃ sayambhuṃ / Nāgacchi kappāni apāyabhūmiṃ satasahassāni phalena tassa.
tha-ap549:31.1: Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Abhayo thero i. g. a-ti.
